description: Olwateso lulimi lwa Nilotic olwogerwa abantu ng’obukadde bubiri n’ekitundu mu buvanjuba bwa Uganda, okwetooloola Soroti, Kumi, Serere ne Amuria, n’Abateso b’e Kenya.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Ateso courses (#131) with low confidence in Ateso; needs a native-speaker review. The Luganda needs a native-speaker review too; word and unit notes fall back to the English notes (lang/en/about/teo).

why.title: Olulimi lwa **Soroti, Kumi n’ennyanja za Teso.**
why.text: Olwateso luli mu kika kya Ateker wamu n’Olukaramoja n’Oluturukana, kale bw’oluyiga oggulawo ennimi nnyingi okuva mu Uganda okutuuka e Kenya ne South Sudan. Luyige olw’ab’omu maka, entambula, emirimu, n’ennyimba, amazina n’engero za Teso.

cards.title: Eri ab’omu maka
cards.text: Yogera ne bajjajja n’ab’eŋŋanda e Soroti ne Kumi.

cards.title: Eri abatambuze
cards.text: Tambula okuva e Soroti okutuuka e Kumi, Ngora ne ku nnyanja Bisina.

cards.title: Eri abaagala okumanya
cards.text: Zuula olulimi lwa Nilotic olulina amannya ag’ekikazi n’ekisajja, era nga terulina bika bya mannya.

landing.audience: Aboogera Oluganda abatandika okuva ku ntandikwa, ab’omu maka abava mu Teso, n’abatambuze abagenda mu buvanjuba bwa Uganda.
landing.first: Okulamusa, okweyanjula n’ennamba, oluvannyuma ab’omu maka, emmere, akatale, essaawa, ebifo, awaka n’obulamu, ekitundu ku kitundu.

cast.emma: Omugenyi ayiga Olwateso nga tannaba kutambula
